title: GitHub MCP Server
summary: Connect your coding agent to GitHub's official MCP server to read issues, pull requests, code and Actions runs without leaving the chat.
description: GitHub's official MCP server lets an agent search code, read and comment on issues and pull requests, and check Actions runs on the repositories your token can see.
This setup uses the hosted server, so there is nothing to install: add the config and give it a personal access token.
useWhen: Review a pull request with the agent
Check why a CI run failed

mcp.name: github
access: Repositories, issues and pull requests your token can see

example.prompt: Which open issues are labeled bug and have no assignee?
example.result: 4 issues: #212 Login fails on Safari, #219 CSV export drops the last row, ...

faq.question: Where do I get a token?
faq.answer: GitHub Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens. Give it only the scopes you need.

faq.question: Can it push code?
faq.answer: Only if your token allows it. A read-only token keeps it read-only.
